ambient_events: A missile sits half-out of its rack on the hoist, fins gleaming with fresh grease.
The launch electronics tick and hum behind a cage of red-taped cabling.
The mount grinds overhead and grit rains from the ceiling joists.
description: The dugout under the Redline nest: a low earth-and-plate bunker reeking of solvent and cordite, strung with red-taped cable and caged worklights. Spare missiles ride a hand-cranked hoist up to the rail above; the launch electronics and the seeker-cooling gear crowd a bench along the back wall. This is where the nest is fed and, when a gun run tears the rail apart, rebuilt. A steel ladder climbs to the sprung hatch and the open deck.
name: Redline SAM Nest — Bunker
